description: Script binding for mods (games-quickjs@1): game.storage get/set/delete/keys, key/value storage per mod per place on the Games database: keys up to 128 bytes, values up to 8 KB of JSON, at most 1000 keys and 1 MB per mod per place, writes counted against the mod's CPU budget; a refusal is an error inside the mod. Absent unless granted.
